name: spondyloarthritis overview
title: Spondyloarthritis: inflammatory back pain points to ankylosing spondylitis, psoriasis to psoriatic arthritis, and a gut or genital infection weeks before to reactive arthritis; each column gives presentation, exam and tests, and treatment in order

root.title: Inflammatory back pain or lower-limb oligoarthritis, rheumatoid factor NEGATIVE: which spondyloarthritis (SpA)?
lines: shared: sacroiliitis · enthesitis · dactylitis · anterior uveitis · HLA-B27 · raised sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein · good response to anti-inflammatories (NSAIDs)

groups.title: Gut or genital infection 1-3 weeks before

head: h
Ankylosing spondylitis
the prototype · HLA-B27 in > 90% (white patients)
but 8% of everyone carries HLA-B27
pres: Starts at the sacroiliac joints, climbs
inv: bilateral, symmetric: iliac-side erosion → sclerosis → fusion
bone marrow edema = non-radiographic axial SpA
tx: 3 · Tumour necrosis factor (TNF) or interleukin-17 (IL-17) inhibitor
conventional disease-modifying drugs do NOT work in the spine

head: h
Psoriatic arthritis
5-7% of people with psoriasis
HLA-B27, B38, B39, DR4
pres: • arthritis first or together in ⅓
• hidden: scalp, navel, behind ears, perianal, nails
• mostly distal finger joints 5-10% · arthritis mutilans 5%
tx: • TNF inhibitor: skin, joints, spine, nails
• IL-17: skin + spine · IL-12/23: NOT the spine

head: h
Reactive arthritis
young men, 20-40 · HLA-B27 linked
NOT 'Reiter's syndrome'
pres: Can't see, can't pee, can't climb a tree
inv: NOT an infection of the joint

panels.title: Inflammatory vs mechanical back pain
items: inflammatory: under 40 · insidious · > 3 months · stiffness > 60 min · night pain · BETTER with activity · sacroiliac tender · chest expansion ↓ · neuro deficit unlikely
mechanical: any age · acute · < 4 weeks · stiffness < 30 min · WORSE with activity · neuro deficit possible

panels.title: Also in the family
items: arthritis with Crohn's or ulcerative colitis
acute anterior uveitis · undifferentiated SpA · juvenile (enthesitis-related)
